create_SequencePooler: create a SequencePooler instance with a pooling method and head for sequence-level pooling
build_pooler_for_embed: build an embedding pooler from a PoolerConfig that normalizes pooled embeddings
build_pooler_for_classify: build a classifier pooler from a PoolerConfig with optional pooling, classifier, and activation functions
test_SequencePooler_forward: test the SequencePooler forward method that applies pooling then head postprocessing to hidden states
review_SequencePooler_get_supported_task: review the SequencePooler get_supported_tasks method that intersects supported tasks from pooling and head
